findings: All five tables are visible at actual manuscript placement; enlarged and paper-size renderings show no clipped cells, overlapping numbers, missing minus signs or broken rules.
Transport rows are labeled (ours), with a subtle row tint. Green bold marks positive point gains and the captions explicitly distinguish this from statistical significance.
Both negative transport-versus-context-off rows and all seven inconclusive interval daggers are retained. Action-free pooled-h10 regression -1.613% is also visible in the full-arm table.
Table38 contains all fifteen selected epochs and actual active parameter counts; source and loaded model counts agree.
The method equations and qualification of semantic mixing as neither physical image warping nor an accuracy guarantee remain clear.
nonblocking_notes: Page59 has generous vertical white space between two floated tables; this is a layout refinement opportunity, not a legibility or correctness issue.

The prose says active counts differ slightly; this is accurate for transport versus additive (+1.84%) but context-off has14.40% fewer active parameters. The exact counts are visible; replacing slightly with by arm would be more precise.

interpretation.strongest_supported: Native4x4 h10 transport versus matched autoregression:5.2998% lower mean error; paired first-minus-second CI[-0.0124606,-0.0090283].
interpretation.additional_supported: Native4x4 h10 transport improves on anchored additive by3.5469% and action-free by4.5031%; both paired intervals favor transport. Actions matter within this package comparison.
interpretation.context_effect: Native h5/h10 gains0.0477%/0.0973% and pooled h5/h10 changes-0.1937%/-0.1078% all have intervals including zero. This study does not establish that support context improves accuracy; lack of significance is not proof of equivalence.
interpretation.coordinate_dependence: Original2x2 h10 gains versus autoregression remain positive2.5378% with interval below zero, while gain versus anchored additive is only0.4719% and inconclusive. Native and pooled metrics use different normalizations; the stronger native comparison cannot be substituted for a pooled-coordinate result.
interpretation.causal_limit: Mixing, bounded innovation, initialization, and small active-capacity differences are bundled. This five-arm study does not isolate a transport or bounding mechanism and does not prove physical correspondence.
interpretation.scope: Registered exploratory original-validation development; no fresh-test use, no multiple-comparison adjustment, no SOTA claim or implied real-robot deployment result.
interpretation.checkpoint_selection: All30epochs completed; selected epochs span4–25. Transport seeds select14/19/11, not the old h5 campaign early epoch1 pattern. This alone does not isolate why generalization improved.

limitations: Checkpoint completion/source identities and ledger arithmetic were rechecked; all training and GPU predictions were not rerun.
Public relocated offline prediction proof is byte/hash-bound and passes for all15models; this audit did not repeat every inference in a newly relocated environment.
